decisions.reason: Fair: the rule compared the problem search only with the two keyword searches. It now has two questions, each against all four searches: is search alone enough, using the best of the four, and does the problem search add anything over the best of the other three.

Fair: the problem search returns its merged list by best score, so the smallest place per sub-problem rule gave a different order. Each search now has one placement rule, and the problem search uses its merged list order; the tests and breaks name it.

Fair: the roadmap makes pair judging depend on the result showing search alone is not enough. The plan now recommends it only on that reading, and says that starting it against the reading would be a change of direction for the owner.
